messages:
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout v2.3.1-rc2 -> production (staged, US -> EU -> APAC). Canary window 15m per region. change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. link: https://releases.redwood.ai/2.3.1-rc2 :rocket:
maria: starting preflight thread for the three-region staged cutover. please confirm capacity and any sticky quota issues for each region. I'll hold on kick unless all green.
jonah: US pool checks done. Dedicated GPU pool 'us-west-2-gpu-a' at 72% utilization, autoscale headroom 4 nodes, canary slice reserved. no pin conflicts.
priya: EU status: 'eu-central-1-gpu-b' currently 65% util, but quota for burst GPUs set to 8, we've got 6 available. noting a lingering job from analytics that might spike at 03:30 UTC — warned them to avoid heavy runs.
samira: APAC: 'ap-northeast-1-gpu-c' is tighter, 84% overall. we have 2 spare nodes but autoscale cold-start ~45s. recommend smaller canary (5%) in APAC and traffic pin fallback ready.
maria: thanks. ops-oncall, any global infra cautions?
ops-oncall: watching a degraded AZ in ap-northeast-1 but not critical. recommend: pin fallback route to v2.2.9 in APAC and set canary slice 5% there, 10% EU, 15% US.
jonah: agree with pins. also suggest enabling prefix cache warmup for canary so first requests aren't slow.
priya: added cache-warmup job to release plan. snippet: ```bash
# warmup prompt set for canary
curl -X POST $RELEASE_WARMUP_URL -d @warmup_prompts.json
```
maria: deploy-bot, verify rollout policy matches pins and fallback.
deploy-bot: rollout plan validated. pins: APAC -> v2.2.9 fallback, EU -> auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if error rate > 3% for 5m, US -> auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if latency p95 > 2s for 10m. Canary slices set as requested.
samira: quick ops note: if APAC cold-starts spike, we might exceed SKUs in account. pre-approved emergency add requires 2 engineers to confirm. we should avoid automatic scaling above 10 nodes.
jonah: acknowledge. setting max_nodes=10 in the canary config.
priya: updated canary config in the release PR: https://git.internal/release/2.3.1-rc2/changes. also added rollback playbook link in the PR.
maria: ok timeline: start US canary 1965435600 (now +~5m), wait 15m, if green -> EU canary, wait 15m, then APAC small canary. everyone on standby for rollback decision.
ops-oncall: I'll run synthetic checks and push alerts to #incidents if thresholds exceed.
jonah: I'll watch GPU queue and model server error logs. command I will run if errors: `kubectl logs -l app=model-server -n prod | grep ERROR`
priya: watch eval harness for regression alerts too, I wired eval alerts to this thread.
maria: RSVP with :thumbsup: when you're at your console and ready to hit go.
jonah: :thumbsup:
priya: :thumbsup:
samira: :thumbsup: (APAC will be narrower slice)
ops-oncall: standing by.
maria: launching US canary now. deploy-bot: start canary slice for region=us, percent=15.
deploy-bot: canary started for region=us, slice=15%, version=v2.3.1-rc2. canary_start_ts=1965435600. monitoring hooks active.
johnathan: (reaction) good luck
jonah: seeing cold-starts ~350ms, p95 ~1.1s, error rate 0.1%. GPU queues stable.
priya: EU warmup running.
samira: APAC prepped, but will not be promoted until final gate.
ops-oncall: synthetic latency p95 US = 1.15s, error rate 0.08%, cost projection within expected. green so far.
maria: hold 10m more then promote EU.
priya: promoting EU canary slice=10% now.
deploy-bot: canary started for region=eu, slice=10%, version=v2.3.1-rc2. canary_start_ts=1965436420.
priya: EU p95 ~1.4s, small spike in model mem but within margin.
samira: double-check APAC fallback pinned in the routing table: `curl -s http://routing.internal/pins | jq '.apac'` shows fallback=v2.2.9.
maria: good. if EU stays green, we'll plan APAC micro-canary at 5% and hold for 30m due to cold-starts.
ops-oncall: setting extended watch: APAC 30m. if p95>2.5s or error >2% -> rollback APAC and engage emergency add.
priya: EU holding green at 10m, no regressions.
jonah: US steady.
samira: starting APAC micro-canary 5% now, deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: canary started for region=apac, slice=5%, version=v2.3.1-rc2. canary_start_ts=1965438000.
samira: immediate cold-start spike to p95 2.6s — ops-oncall watching.
ops-oncall: threshold breached. triggering automatic fallback for APAC -> v2.2.9.
deploy-bot: APAC fallback initiated. traffic routed to v2.2.9. fallback_ts=1965438200.
maria: rolling back APAC only. teams, do postmortem notes in the release PR re: cold-start and warmup tuning.
priya: adding note: increase warmup batch and pre-warmed node count for APAC in next release.
jonah: will prepend additional GPU warmup in the pipeline.
samira: will follow up with cloud quota request for APAC to allow faster autoscale next time.
ops-oncall: marking this rollout event as partial rollback (APAC). EU & US promoted. I'll open an incident if anything follows.
maria: thanks everyone. final state: US/EU on v2.3.1-rc2, APAC on v2.2.9 fallback. draft release notes updated with region statuses and rollback rationale: https://releases.redwood.ai/2.3.1-rc2/notes.
priya: will schedule a short retro tomorrow to tweak warmup heuristics.
johnathan: thumbs for the run. :thumbsup:
maria: closing thread, but keep alerts to this channel for 1h. great job.
